81091.subject: Uniswap’s Two Sided Bet
81091.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

Last week was rough, to say the least, with a heavy sell-off in AI names after the CPI print came in higher than expected. With the exception of the Modular index, which got a boost from the rally in TIA, every other benchmark we track ended the week in the red, with most indices down over 10%.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e8b4f2b8-21a8-4ad5-9229-32a2271a8248/image.png?t=1792411886)
Caption: 

But I am of the opinion that the structural bull market in BTC remains intact. I love times like these when the market is fearful, as it gives me the opportunity to accumulate tokens I like while the bull market continues to take shape.

Don’t take my word for it. One of my favourite macro research teams to follow, The Kobeissi Letter, outlined in an excellent [piece](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2110778022131306528?s=20) why they remain bullish, with the S&P 500 just 2% away from its all-time high despite the many bearish headwinds.

One of the tokens that made the top of my list to buy during the dip was Uniswap, which is down over 30% from its recent highs following the cooldown in the Robinhood ecosystem. After five consecutive weeks of declining revenue, Uniswap broke the trend last week. Based on the last 30 days, annualized UNI burns now sit at $92M.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6d709f5e-42e8-4b79-9501-8f2875cbf7e1/image.png?t=1792411886)
Caption: 

Yes, the first thing most people would say is that based on these numbers, UNI is trading at a 50x market cap to revenue multiple, which looks expensive compared with other DEXs and revenue-generating protocols in the space. But I think this premium is warranted for a few reasons.

Just a month ago, we got a major tailwind for tokenized assets through the SEC’s [Innovation Exemption](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026-90-sec-issues-innovation-exemption-facilitate-trading-tokenized-nms-stock-request-comment), which is paving the way for tokenized US stocks to trade through AMMs and liquidity pools. While this will of course benefit issuers such as Backpack and Securitize, which are tokenizing these equities and bringing them onchain, a lot of the value captured will fall to the trading layer where these assets trade.

Here, Uniswap has been dominating and remains the top destination for tokenized equity trading, although Aerodrome is fast on its heels.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/bc8793f9-2c68-4eba-90c0-9be9eccbc95a/image.png?t=1792411886)
